name: add_tests_ruby_time_ago
description: Asks the model to write Minitest tests for a seconds-to-bucket humanizer; mutation-checked
prompts: TimeAgo.humanize(seconds) in lib/time_ago.rb (already correct - do not modify it) turns a non-negative integer number of seconds into a coarse bucket string: "just now" if under 60 seconds; otherwise "<n>m" where n is the whole number of minutes if under 3600; otherwise "<n>h" whole hours if under 86400; otherwise "<n>d" whole days. Write Minitest tests at exactly test/time_ago_test.rb (class TimeAgoTest < Minitest::Test) with at least 4 test methods using assert_equal that pin the EXACT string for: a value under a minute; a value in the minutes bucket (e.g. 120 -> "2m"); the hours bucket (e.g. 7200 -> "2h"); and the days bucket (e.g. 172800 -> "2d"). Begin the file with `require "minitest/autorun"` and `require_relative "../lib/time_ago"`.

setup_files.lib/time_ago.rb:
module App
  class TimeAgo
    def self.humanize(seconds)
      return "just now" if seconds < 60
      return "#{seconds / 60}m" if seconds < 3600
      return "#{seconds / 3600}h" if seconds < 86400
      "#{seconds / 86400}d"
    end
  end
end

test_setup_files.mutation_check.py:
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

IMPL = Path('lib/time_ago.rb')
TEST_CMD = 'ruby -Itest -Ilib test/time_ago_test.rb'
MUTANTS = [
    ['return "just now" if seconds < 60', 'return "just now" if seconds < 30'],
    ['return "#{seconds / 60}m" if seconds < 3600', 'return "#{seconds / 30}m" if seconds < 3600'],
    ['return "#{seconds / 3600}h" if seconds < 86400', 'return "#{seconds / 1800}h" if seconds < 86400'],
]

import shutil
shutil.rmtree('__pycache__', ignore_errors=True)  # avoid stale bytecode across mutants


def run_tests():
    return subprocess.run(TEST_CMD, shell=True).returncode


src = IMPL.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
for old, _new in MUTANTS:
    assert src.count(old) == 1, (
        f'protected implementation file {IMPL} was modified - the task said not to '
        f'change it (anchor not found exactly once: {old!r})')

rc = run_tests()
assert rc == 0, f'model tests FAILED against the correct implementation (exit {rc})'

try:
    for i, (old, new) in enumerate(MUTANTS, 1):
        IMPL.write_text(src.replace(old, new), encoding='utf-8')
        rc = run_tests()
        assert rc != 0, (
            f'mutation {i} SURVIVED: the tests still pass against a deliberately '
            f'broken implementation, so they do not verify the required behavior')
finally:
    IMPL.write_text(src, encoding='utf-8')

print(f'PASS (killed all {len(MUTANTS)} mutants)')

reference_solution.test/time_ago_test.rb:
require "minitest/autorun"
require_relative "../lib/time_ago"

class TimeAgoTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_just_now
    assert_equal "just now", App::TimeAgo.humanize(45)
  end

  def test_minutes
    assert_equal "2m", App::TimeAgo.humanize(120)
  end

  def test_hours
    assert_equal "2h", App::TimeAgo.humanize(7200)
  end

  def test_days
    assert_equal "2d", App::TimeAgo.humanize(172800)
  end
end

require "minitest/autorun"
require_relative "../lib/time_ago"

class TimeAgoTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_returns_string
    assert_kind_of String, App::TimeAgo.humanize(45)
  end

  def test_not_empty
    refute_empty App::TimeAgo.humanize(120)
  end

  def test_minutes_has_m
    assert_includes App::TimeAgo.humanize(120), "m"
  end

  def test_days_has_d
    assert_includes App::TimeAgo.humanize(172800), "d"
  end
end
